meta.title: Cooking Stories
meta.description: Cooking stories from all over the world. Find something to cook, keep notes in the margin and write down recipes of your own.

home.eyebrow: Cooking stories from all over the world
home.title: What are we cooking today?
home.intro: Find something to cook in the collection, or write down a recipe of your own and decide who gets to see it.
home.worldTitle: Where shall we cook from tonight?
home.worldIntro: Browse recipes by country, or add one from yours.
home.worldEmpty: No stories yet. Write the first one.
home.notebookTitle: Write down your own cooking stories
home.notebookIntro: Your family’s recipes, or the dish you finally got right last night. Keep them to yourself or share them with everyone.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We’ll email you a link. Click it and you’re in, no password needed.
signIn.sent: Check your inbox. The link works for the next 10 minutes.
signIn.error: Something went wrong sending the link. Please try again.

footer.tagline: Cooking stories from all over the world

notFound.title: We couldn’t find that page
notFound.body: The recipe may have moved, or it was never public.

admin.title: Admin
admin.ingredientsHint: One per line. Start a line with # to begin a section, for example “# For the glaze”.
admin.countryHint: Two letters, for example GR or IT. Leave it empty if you’re not sure.
admin.saved: Saved. The public page already shows the change.
admin.machineNote: This text is a machine translation. Saving it marks it as checked by a person.

notebook.title: My notebook
notebook.intro: Your own recipes, the ones you saved, and your notes. Only you can see this page.
notebook.noRecipes: You haven’t written a recipe yet.
notebook.noFavorites: Tap the heart on a recipe page and it shows up here.
notebook.noNotes: Notes you write on a recipe page show up here.

editor.title: Title
editor.titlePlaceholder: What do they call it at home?
editor.descriptionHint: One or two sentences shown under the title.
editor.storyHint: Optional. Where did you learn it, and who used to make it?
editor.ingredientsHint: One per line. Start a line with # to begin a section, for example “# For the glaze”.
editor.stepsHint: One step per line. Write times out, like “bake for 40 minutes”, and cook mode turns them into timers.
editor.countryHint: Two letters, for example GR or IT. Leave it empty if you’re not sure.

link.title: Anyone with the link
link.text: For family and friends. Not shown on the site.

public.title: Everyone
public.text: Listed on the site after a quick review.

editor.reviewNote: Public recipes get a quick review before they appear, and again after each change.
editor.shareHint: Anyone with this link can read the recipe.
editor.invalid: Something is missing. A title, at least one ingredient and one step are needed.

recipeTools.notesPlaceholder: e.g. a little less sugar in the glaze
recipeTools.notesSignIn: Sign in to keep private notes on this recipe.
recipeTools.onlyYou: Only you can see this recipe.
recipeTools.onlyLink: Only people with the link can see this recipe.
recipeTools.pending: Waiting for review. Only you can see it until then.
recipeTools.rejected: Not approved for the public site. Only you can see it.

cook.title: Cook mode
cook.screenOn: Your screen stays on while you cook
cook.doneText: You made {title}. How did it go?
cook.notesSignIn: Sign in on the recipe page to keep notes.
cook.keys: Use the arrow keys to move between steps.
